name: stochastic_breath_by_breath_synthesis
mechanism: Synthesizes the respiratory signal iteratively breath-by-breath to allow for natural stochastic variation in inspiration, expiration, and pause durations within a single recording.
code_snippet: while idx < len(t): t_i = np.random.normal(1.2, 0.1); t_e = np.random.normal(3.0, 0.3); ...

name: use_brown_background_noise
mechanism: Replaces pink noise with brown noise for the background floor to better simulate the acoustic damping of the body and reduce unnatural high-frequency energy.

name: add_narrowband_noise_to_wheezes
mechanism: Adds bandpass-filtered Gaussian noise centered at the fundamental frequency to tonal wheeze signals to reduce synthetic purity and simulate a breathy texture.
code_snippet: sos_nb = signal.butter(2, [max(20, f0 - 50), min(SR/2 - 1, f0 + 50)], btype='bandpass', fs=SR, output='sos')

name: randomize_filter_order
mechanism: Randomizes the order of the Butterworth low-pass filter to increase the diversity of spectral roll-off characteristics.

name: widen_crackle_bandwidth
mechanism: Increased the upper cutoff frequency of the bandpass filter for coarse crackles from 600 Hz to 1200 Hz to better capture broadband transient energy.

name: slowed_expiratory_envelope_decay
mechanism: Decreasing the exponential decay rate of the expiratory envelope sustains signal energy longer, preventing extreme sparsity and improving the RMS-to-peak ratio.
